cohort_total_n_excerpt: After IRB approval, more than 1903 men enrolled in a prospective cohort from 2000 to 2010 as part of the SABOR clinical validation site for the National Cancer Institute Early Detection Research Network.
reason: The prospective SABOR cohort evaluates subsequent overall prostate cancer diagnosis. No aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal incidence endpoint is analyzed. The exact analytic participant count is unavailable because the abstract states only that more than 1903 men enrolled.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There was an increased risk of PCa with increasing intake of monounsaturated fatty acid (MUFA) (HR per quintile 1.14; 95% CI 1.03-1.27, P = 0.01, FDR 0.15) and cholesterol [HR per quintile 1.13; 95% confidence interval (95% CI) (1.02-1.26), P-value 0.02, FDR 0.19].
estimate_classifications.reason: The MUFA hazard ratio is for overall incident prostate cancer, not an aggressive subtype.
